evaluation_basis: Assessed for immutable-artifact aggregation, snapshot independence and fail-closed thesis reporting; no optimizer existed in this stage.
original_objective: Aggregate v0.15 artifacts, remove rapid duplicate snapshots and generate formal Chapter 4/defense evidence without manufacturing sample size.

engineering_result.summary: The eight-file defense artifact and integrity manifest were produced; 7 deterministic tests passed and only one genuinely independent snapshot was retained.

scientific_result.summary: Sample gate, risk-ratio authorization, alpha claim, profitability claim and LIVE promotion all remained false.

economic_result.summary: The earlier -0.0261% PAPER snapshot was retained only descriptively; no positive or negative expectancy conclusion was drawn.

contribution_to_next_version: Demonstrated defensible forward-evidence reporting and preserved insufficient-sample conclusions instead of annualizing duplicate snapshots.
